summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA (published 2026-09-20) upgrades Applied Materials to a buy after a 22% pullback since his August 6 analysis, when he warned the stock was too rich at a forward P/E near 40. The business is booming on the AI infrastructure race: 25% year-over-year revenue growth last quarter, guidance for 51% growth next quarter, and trailing-12-month revenue near $31 billion (up ~3x from ~$10 billion in 2017). He stresses the growth is organic: operating margin expanded to 31% (from ~20% in 2017), capacity is nearly fully utilized, and ROIC has been strong for a decade, already above WACC — so aggressive capex should earn adequate returns. The valuation now looks attractive at a forward P/E of 22.7, below its multi-year average. His updated DCF yields a fair value of $378 against a $417 market price; with his 10–15% margin-of-safety applied, DCF shows fairly valued to slightly overvalued, but the comprehensive valuation (multiples plus DCF) reads fairly valued to slightly undervalued. Conviction is low given the fast-changing AI market, and he notes Micron's end-of-September earnings (covered live for channel members only) will reveal more about AI demand. Call: AMAT BUY @ $417.
